quests.title: The Trials of the Burnished Scales
quests.premise: At Hissmir the Root Stewards, who cannot refuse a comer, give the Trials of the Burnished Scales, by which one without a Hist may commune with the Hist.

quests.title: The Weighbridge Book
quests.premise: The weighbridge ledger for the quarter's inbound cargo goes missing. It goes missing the week before the audit.

quests.title: Face Down in the Leat
quests.premise: A crystal cutter is found in the diggings' water channel. Graded stones are sewn into his coat.

quests.title: Only the Ladder Came Back
quests.premise: A licensed party goes down at dusk to a face. The face was signed off as worked out.

quests.title: Names in Fresh Cutting
quests.premise: A hooded mourner adds names to the Flu memorial's count at night. The names are cut in new stone.

quests.title: Graded by Somebody
quests.premise: Ungraded rim stones reach the city under a grading mark. No cutter in the guild will own that grading mark.

quests.title: Under the Deck
quests.premise: The floating auction has an under-deck mooring. That mooring lands cargo that bypasses the weighbridge.

quests.title: The Room With No Door
quests.premise: The Conclave wants the chamber behind the city's falls opened. The Conclave wants it opened before the vicecanons hear of it.

quests.title: The Tablet Reads Back
quests.premise: The Conclave's reading tablet answers a question. The question was not asked aloud.

quests.title: A Tenant in the Family Vault
quests.premise: A household returns to bury its dead. The tomb has had a living occupant for years.

quests.title: Rent Paid by a Dead Man
quests.premise: An upper floor above the terraces is leased in the name of a Dunmer. The Dunmer died before the lease was signed.

quests.title: Ledges Off the Rent Roll
quests.premise: The gorge-wall district pays no ground rent. The city cannot decide whether it owns the rock.

quests.title: Four Claims, One Seam
quests.premise: Four unlicensed prospectors work the rim. One of the four has actually found the seam.

quests.title: Behind the Spoil Ridge
quests.premise: A buyer pays for an unpermitted cut. The buyer has not come north.

quests.title: The City That Only Digs Down
quests.premise: Ayleid surface work stands in daylight. The city quarries beneath the Ayleid surface work. A stone-taker then starts removing the surface work as well.

quests.title: The View They Sold
quests.premise: A guide sells the climb to the crown. A client then does not come down.

quests.title: The Ferry on the Wrong Bank
quests.premise: The causeway ferry runs late every dusk. The late run is the eastbound crossing.

quests.title: The Causeway's Purpose
quests.premise: The tended xanmeer stands at the causeway's end. The city's offering at the xanmeer is refused for the first time in memory.

quests.title: The Safest Floor for an Hour
quests.premise: A cordon cellar is the driest shelter on the rim. The locals will not go near the cellar. A squatter has taken the cellar over.

quests.title: Whose Roofs
quests.premise: A newcomer claims two hundred empty roof frames. The north says no living name can claim them.

quests.title: On No Charge Sheet
quests.premise: A field-owner has a roofed pit. The pit holds people who appear on no city record.

quests.title: The Village That Sank Into Its Spring
quests.premise: A village stood on good ground with a spring. The ground went into the void that fed the spring. The houses went into the void first.

quests.title: One Cellar Under the Holding
quests.premise: A Dunmer holding's cellars joined into a single warren when the ground gave way. Something then moved into the warren.

quests.title: The Water Bites First
quests.premise: A wamasu pond kills two carriers. A third carrier sees the animal.

quests.title: Two Yards, One Set of Hunters
quests.premise: Two charged-goods works bid for the same wamasu stock. The hunters stop selling to either works.

quests.title: Paper in a Marsh House
quests.premise: A cult house keeps its accounts. Keeping accounts is the first mistake that a magistrate can prove.

quests.title: The Fittings Are Still Bolted to the Trees
quests.premise: A tempering ground has its equipment intact. A smith who wants to start the tempering ground again is drawn to it.

quests.title: Sings Under Water
quests.premise: A flooded Ayleid system lies under a citadel. The system has an inscription that only a diver can read.

quests.title: Which Chambers Are Permissible
quests.premise: The divers argue in public about which drowned rooms may be stripped. One drowned room is then stripped.

quests.title: Good Ground Left Standing
quests.premise: Kothringi work stands on the best ground on the road. The villagers give four different reasons for leaving it.

quests.title: They Will Talk Through the Gate
quests.premise: A village has been shut behind its causeway for a decade. The village wants one errand run. The village sets the terms of the errand.

quests.title: The Key Is a Person
quests.premise: A thief carried off a keystone chamber's missing key. The city knows the thief by name.

quests.title: Cold Under the Rock
quests.premise: A surveyor maps root galleries over bare stone. The surveyor is paid from Stormhold.

quests.title: The Feast Outgrew Its Field
quests.premise: The Fish Boon crowd no longer fits the ground that the rite requires. The rite must move or shrink.

quests.title: A Boundary Unwalked in Forty Years
quests.premise: Two houses hold the same saltrice ground. Their titles have not been compared in forty years.

quests.title: One Hand Off the Roll
quests.premise: Thorn's bonded warehouse has a night watchman. The night watchman is not on the watch roll.

quests.title: Below the Licensed Face
quests.premise: People whom the city does not count work the undercity's lowest gallery. The gallery then floods.

quests.title: The Shuttered House
quests.premise: A Dunmer great house stands unlooted after two centuries. A keeper maintains an arrangement that protects the great house.

quests.title: The Counting Room
quests.premise: A plantation's counting room holds the record of who was owned. Two families want different pages of the record.

quests.title: Still Holding Somebody
quests.premise: The Chainbreakers' shelter knows which northern house is still working people. That house says it freed those people.

quests.title: A Promise With Witnesses
quests.premise: A vigil camp holds a land claim. The An-Xileel made the claim aloud but did not write it down.

quests.title: The Manifests Are Still Nailed Up
quests.premise: A slaver's holding yard was abandoned with its paperwork intact. An interested party wants the yard burned.

quests.title: The Standing Half
quests.premise: A blackguard band works out of a burned holding. The holding is close enough to hit the Tear road twice a season.

quests.title: They Still Write Each One Down
quests.premise: A crew with no house left takes people off the old road. The crew then keeps a book about it.

quests.title: A Cellar Under the Toll
quests.premise: A crossroads tradehouse moves goods under the floor. The toll-holder drinks in the room above that floor.

quests.title: The Head-Count Book
quests.premise: Each crossing is written down. The book can prove who did not come back.

quests.title: Salt One Way
quests.premise: An uncounted ledge lies past the border post. The ledge carries salt one way and people the other, for a fee.

quests.title: Two Gates, One Span
quests.premise: Two toll-holders share one bridge. They have not spoken in nine years. Their receipts have started matching.

quests.title: Neither Side Pays for the Roof
quests.premise: A cross-border station will fail this winter. It survives only if one province admits it wants the station.

quests.title: Last Level Ground
quests.premise: A caravan waits at the road stage. The caravan waits for a guarantee that Tear refused a week ago.

quests.title: The Road Cannot Leave the Channels
quests.premise: A Naga camp stands where the road has no way round the channels. The levy finds an empty camp twice a year.

quests.title: When the Boom Comes Down
quests.premise: A depth gauge says the delta section has gone. The town must choose who crosses first.

quests.title: Checked Twice a Year
quests.premise: An officeholder inspects a sealed urn shelter. She keeps the tally in her head.

quests.title: Eight Before This One
quests.premise: A ruined chapel is carved with the number nine. No record survives of the eight missions before it.

quests.title: Who Renews the Posts
quests.premise: A market fund pays for the white marker ring around a Daedric ruin. The fund pays under an entry that the clerk does not itemise.

quests.title: The Rotation Without a Holder
quests.premise: A dry-season grazing rotation holds. It holds until one party's herd grows past it.

quests.title: One Guar for the Right Favour
quests.premise: A herder will part with a glowgill guar for a service. The herder does not want coin for the guar.

quests.title: The Family on the Rock Bar
quests.premise: Salt is the north's second currency. One family controls where the salt comes ashore.

quests.title: Six Hours of Market
quests.premise: A fair on a sand flat has six hours before two metres of water. One seller will not close.

quests.title: Her Cargo Still Stowed
quests.premise: A hull aground upright keeps her hold underwater. That is why the hold has not been emptied.

quests.title: A Window in the Water
quests.premise: Shell-beast armour material can be taken for a fortnight. The reason for the window is still down there.

quests.title: The Lower Terraces Still Work
quests.premise: A xanmeer is held as a fort. Its old mechanisms keep working for whoever holds it this year.

quests.title: The Tree Is Dying
quests.premise: A crown terrace holds a village's dead. The terrace is failing. The burial-keeper will not plan for the failure.

quests.title: Sold Across the Line
quests.premise: A dream-wallow rite is sold to Dunmer buyers. Two communities object to the sale for opposite reasons.

quests.title: The Bed Kept Made
quests.premise: A Sithis rest house is kept ready for a Nisswo. The Nisswo has not come in three years.

quests.title: Offerings Against the Flood
quests.premise: Pilgrims still leave offerings above a pond. They say the pond holds a leviathan. This year the flooding got worse.

quests.title: The Bench Outside the Guild
quests.premise: A cutter outside the guild will work stone brought to him. He does not ask the stone's source. The town would like him stopped.

quests.title: Past the Licensed Face
quests.premise: Crystal lies beyond the boundary that the licence draws. The boundary is a chalk line on rock.

quests.title: The Guild Has No Heir
quests.premise: A hereditary cutting guild's last master will not name a successor. Three candidates wait.

quests.title: They Ran the Licensed Party Off
quests.premise: Claim-jumpers on the scree hold ground. They cannot legally sell from that ground.

quests.title: A Socket Cut to Fit
quests.premise: A keystone chamber was built around an object. The town's records decline to describe the object.

quests.title: The Fast Way Out of the Diggings
quests.premise: A fast way out of the diggings kills more cutters than the faces do. The town keeps the fast way.

quests.title: Daylight Ayleid Work
quests.premise: Surface stone is being lifted from a compound. The town has ignored the compound for centuries.

quests.title: Held by a Pair of Birds
quests.premise: The ledge that shows the channel network is defended by hackwings. The hackwings will not share the ledge.

quests.title: An Urn Short
quests.premise: The officeholder's twice-yearly count comes back one urn light. The count is all the record there is.

quests.title: Buying the Fourth Claim
quests.premise: The town will pay for a rim claim quietly. One of four prospectors must be got out of the way.

quests.title: The Order of Arrival
quests.premise: A waiting camp's queue is its law. The people who have queued longest enforce it.

quests.title: A Certificate the Registry Refuses
quests.premise: A pilgrim passes the Trials. The pilgrim then finds the paper refused downriver.

quests.title: Set Down and Counted
quests.premise: Bone-carriers put down what they carry at the first rest. This season the count is wrong.

quests.title: He Will Only Talk Up There
quests.premise: A Nisswo speaks about death from a ledge. The ledge can be reached only by climbing. An opponent wants the speaking stopped.

quests.title: Hist-Less and Waiting
quests.premise: Pilgrims with no tree to return to have built a grievance. The grievance has nowhere to go.

quests.title: Three Years of a Laid Fire
quests.premise: The rest house on the pilgrim road is kept for a Nisswo. The Nisswo's route ended somewhere between two stages.

quests.title: A Place in the Queue, Sold
quests.premise: Places in the Trials queue are traded for coin. The Stewards refuse to notice the trade.

quests.title: The Trial Goes Wrong
quests.premise: A Trial goes wrong. The Stewards have no procedure to cover it.

quests.title: The Village Moved Overnight
quests.premise: A drifting village was moored off Hissmir yesterday. This morning the village is somewhere else.

quests.title: Two Clerks Who Cannot Agree
quests.premise: A customs house stands on an island. Two clerks staff it. Their rulings contradict each other daily.

quests.title: Above the Sill, Below the Sill
quests.premise: Boats stop at the head of navigation. The porters above it can hold the whole route to ransom.

quests.title: Prices Set by the Last Trip
quests.premise: The pilots price the channels by rumour. One bad rumour is planted deliberately.

quests.title: The Unwritten Rota
quests.premise: A fishing bank runs on an unwritten rota. A buyer offers enough to break the rota.

quests.title: Eggs Out of Season
quests.premise: An egg-taker gathers eggs against a quota. Four villages enforce the quota absolutely.

quests.title: Seized, Then Sunk
quests.premise: The customs house condemned a hull. The hull went aground before it could be unloaded.

quests.title: The Second Currency
quests.premise: Salt from the pans is paid out as wages. The arrangement suits the pan-holders. It suits the labourers who are paid in salt less.

quests.title: Buy Now or Wait a Fortnight
quests.premise: A seizure lands at the fair. Four hours of dry ground are left.

quests.title: Two Owners, One Market
quests.premise: A contested estate village sends goods to the port. It sends two sets of goods under one seal.

quests.title: The Cargo That Was Not Aboard
quests.premise: A manifest lists a consignment. The river crews do not remember loading it.

quests.title: Passes and Permits
quests.premise: The toll town has a crossing regime. The regime can be used, forged or made unworkable. Different parties are trying all three.

quests.title: The Records Outlive the Village
quests.premise: The toll town still holds records for a village. Umbriel emptied that village. The buildings stand. The pole field is bare.

quests.title: Still Drawing on a Dead Road
quests.premise: An abandoned roadworks floods ground. The district has not connected that ground to the roadworks.

quests.title: A District's Weapons, Buried
quests.premise: Four villages buried their arms together. One of the four is having second thoughts.

quests.title: The Winter Causeway
quests.premise: A hard causeway crosses impassable ground. People with no right to toll it are tolling it.

quests.title: Who Is Coming
quests.premise: The watch knoll reports a column. The toll town's own books say the column cannot exist.

quests.title: The Saltrice Line
quests.premise: The border runs through a field. Two claimants harvest the crop twice.

quests.title: Stopped Mid-Course on Purpose
quests.premise: A xanmeer has been kept unfinished since the Duskfall. It attracts a builder. The builder wants to finish it.

quests.title: What Could Not Be Carried
quests.premise: A broken-open xanmeer holds what the first diggers could not carry. The second party came to take it.

quests.title: The Levy's Own Man
quests.premise: A gate levy's own man is on two payrolls. The second payroll is across the border.

quests.title: Weights and the Factor
quests.premise: The Marsh Charter factor has authority over weights. That authority is worth more than the goods on the scale.

quests.title: The Naming and the Registry
quests.premise: An Imperial registry wants to record a naming rite. The villages hold that the rite is not recordable.

quests.title: The Allocation Fails
quests.premise: A dry year concentrates every animal on three pools. The hunting allocation breaks down.

quests.title: Four Villages Say Leave It
quests.premise: A stone turns without being turned. An outsider studies the stone. Four communities have asked the outsider to stop.

quests.title: The Ninth Mark
quests.premise: Eight marks can be found. The ninth mark completes something. The district would prefer that it stayed incomplete.

quests.title: Fire in the Peat
quests.premise: The winter fuel of three villages burns under their feet. One dropped lamp could set it alight.

quests.title: The Pipes Have Gone Quiet
quests.premise: A frog-pond farm supplies a craft chain. The farm loses its stock in a week.

quests.title: A Night Booked in Advance
quests.premise: A calcinator court can be worked on one phase of the moon. A saboteur spoils the darkness that the work needs.

quests.title: The Herd That Grew
quests.premise: A grazing rotation breaks. One household's herd doubled in a season.

quests.title: The Courier Line Drops
quests.premise: A courier route runs through the market hinge. The route loses two runs in a row. Both losses are in the same direction.

quests.title: Both Sides Are Hiring
quests.premise: A contested estate village pays two wages for the same day's work. The arrangement cannot last the season.

quests.title: The Estate's Second Book
quests.premise: One owner's rent book records tenants. The other owner's book does not list those tenants.

quests.title: The Squatter Knows the Family
quests.premise: A man lives in a Dunmer tomb. He can name the household whose tomb it is. For that reason the villagers do not turn him out.

quests.title: Four Districts by Morning
quests.premise: A tie-up village hears the river talk. A lie that is planted there reaches four districts by morning.

quests.title: The Ferry Family's Terms
quests.premise: A ferry family crosses for the whole village. The family refuses one household and gives no reason.

quests.title: Neutral Water
quests.premise: Four communities meet on water held in common. One of them has brought more people than agreed.

quests.title: A Stranger's Question
quests.premise: The Hist here will answer an outsider. People queue to buy an outsider's mouth.

quests.title: Declared Off Limits
quests.premise: The village minders forbid a stretch of drowned ruin. They cannot actually patrol that stretch.

quests.title: Keepers of the Shell
quests.premise: The regional hatchery is asked to take a clutch. No village will admit to sending the clutch.

quests.title: Rune Totems Punish the Rude
quests.premise: The totems enforce a courtesy. A visitor breaks the courtesy. The visitor then asks the village to undo the breach.

quests.title: It Knows What Was Done
quests.premise: A harmed Hist will describe its own injury. It tells the account to a listener who can bear it.

quests.title: The Flood Warning
quests.premise: A lookout platform shows a flood coming. The district disagrees about who should be told first.

quests.title: The Building Has Resumed
quests.premise: Work on a stone city has started again. The work requires the tree to be held harder.

quests.title: The Stone Heresy
quests.premise: A carver argues that stone records the dead better than sap does. The village is beginning to agree.

quests.title: The Route Is in His Head
quests.premise: A walkway keeper holds route knowledge that exists nowhere else. He has started forgetting it.

quests.title: The Executioner Kept Her Tools
quests.premise: A retired executioner is asked for one more piece of work. The people who ask know what she was.

quests.title: Far Enough to Deny It
quests.premise: The village can see the tempering ground from its own water. The villagers insist that they cannot see it.

quests.title: Water on Every Side
quests.premise: A hummock village floods from one direction. The village has no defence against that direction.

quests.title: Eight Other Fords
quests.premise: A toll town survives because the alternative routes are worse. A rival builder is improving one of those routes.

quests.title: The Bridge They Keep Buying Off
quests.premise: Interested parties buy off a bridge proposal every few years. This time the buyer has run out of money.

quests.title: The Bell Rings Nightly
quests.premise: A warning bell sounds every night. No boat or beast in the water warrants it.

quests.title: A Bed on Legs
quests.premise: A landlord lets a stilt house to two households at once. The landlord has left the district.

quests.title: Thorn and Hissmir Claim the Halt
quests.premise: Thorn and Hissmir both tax the cove village. The village stands at the mouth of the pilgrim water. Paying either of them counts as taking its side.

quests.title: Argued Nightly
quests.premise: The nightly toll argument turns into an accusation. A witness can prove the accusation.

quests.title: The Cove Silted Overnight
quests.premise: The sounded way across the cove to the ferry stage silts up overnight. The boat-holders do not believe that the silting was natural.

quests.title: Four Banks' Worth of Gossip
quests.premise: The rise that stays dry hears four accounts of the same night. The four accounts disagree.

quests.title: The Spear in the Dry Bed
quests.premise: A grassland field turns up a weapon. The weapon settles an inheritance. Two families had left the inheritance unsettled.

quests.title: Buried in the Ground or Above It
quests.premise: A village splits over whether its dead may go into rented earth.

quests.title: Priced Off the Dry Ground
quests.premise: The firm ground for two kilometres around is rented. This season the rent doubles.

quests.title: The Wrappings Come Down
quests.premise: A crown tree is dying. It will soon drop a village's dead. The village has chosen no site.

quests.title: Still Expecting Somebody
quests.premise: Morrowind veterans hold a ridge. They hold it against an order. The order was countermanded generations ago.

quests.title: The Physician's Second Book
quests.premise: A physician keeps treatment notes. The notes double as a record of who descends from whom.

quests.title: Ledge and Ladder
quests.premise: A rockfall cuts the only access to a vertical district. A saboteur arranged the fall.

quests.title: Two or Three Fixed Moorings
quests.premise: A drifting village keeps a few permanent ties. One of the ties is holding something down.

quests.title: Losing Its Young
quests.premise: A terrace village's last resupply trade fails. Its young people leave for the city.
